text:
Maya: Opening a follow-up thread for yesterday's PD storm — want a short actionable list to reduce pages. ~120 PD incidents in ~40m, mostly from inference hosts and a couple of noisy model errors. We manually squelched during the incident but need durable fixes: dedupe, grouping keys, and per-rule rate caps.

Sam: Agreed. Quick summary from logs: three rules were the loudest: `inference-oom`, `kv-cache-evict-errors`, and `ingress-backpressure`. Each used host as the grouping key so PD exploded when autoscale churned hosts.

Leo: Proposed fix: change grouping key from `host` -> `service:region:model_family`. That merges errors per logical shard instead of per VM. Add dedupe window 15m and per-rule rate_limit = 2/min, burst = 5. Should stop the fanout without hiding real incidents.

Alex: From a customer-impact perspective: only ~0.8% of requests saw elevated latency/errors. Support ticket volume spiked, but no data loss. CSE already sent a short status note. We don't need an outbound incident email but we should avoid PD churn.

Maya: Good call. No external comms required right now — focus on pager noise. @Sam can you push the alert change and @Leo update the dashboard?

Sam: On it. I'll open a PR to the alerts repo. Planning to apply staged rollout: first update grouping + dedupe on staging, smoke test with synthetic traffic, then roll to prod. YAML snippet I'll apply (example):

```yaml
- alert: inference_oom
  expr: node_memory_* > 0 # placeholder
  labels:
    severity: high
    grouping: "{{service}}:{{region}}:{{model_family}}"
  pagerduty: true
  dedupe_window: 15m
  rate_limit:
    per_minute: 2
    burst: 5
```

pd-bot: PagerDuty: Received update request — will apply dedupe for rule IDs [a1b2c3, d4e5f6] with a 15m window once PR is merged. You will see dedup notifications in 2m.

Leo: I'll add an "Alert Churn" panel to the inference dashboard that graphs unique PD incidents over rolling 15m and a simulated dedupe reduction line. Will also add a toggle to show per-model-family counts. Commit message: `dashboard: add alert-churn panel + dedupe-sim`.

Maya: Also let's add an incident-mode quiet window for low-severity alerts: tag `temp-squelch` that routes low/medium to #eng-oncall with no PD for 20m while we triage. We'll document the runbook steps.

Sam: After rolling changes, expected PD page reduction ~85-95% for these patterns. I'll monitor for 30m and report back. If we still see >10 pages in 15m, we'll revert.

Alex: I've added a short note in the post-incident doc (placeholder link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2755554321) summarizing customer impact and mitigation rationale.

Maya: Thanks team. Follow-ups: @Sam add changelog + PR link in the doc, @Leo push dashboard PR, and we'll review in 24h to adjust thresholds. :white_check_mark:

Sam: PR opened: https://git.internal/alerts/pull/342 — will merge after staging smoke.

Leo: Dashboard PR: https://git.internal/dashboards/pull/98 — adding panel and notes.

pd-bot: PagerDuty: Changes applied to production dedupe settings for listed rules. Monitoring for noise suppression.

Maya: Closing thread for now — will reopen if noise resumes. Thanks. :pray:
